items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Then we got Milton Fletcher on trumpet.

ctx.x: Just, you know, looking at the recordings from 1929 to 1940 seems to be four distinct bands. The first band, and then the 1931 band, and then there was a big change in the middle of 1937.

Yeah, I was going to say '36, but I know -- that's when Hayes Alvis came into the band. We changed the brass section, they changed the -- little-George Dixon was still with us. Then we got Milton Fletcher on trumpet.
